b1.skinner_leads_the_dead_into_liscor.news: At sunset a horde of undead from the ruins broke into Liscor through open gates. The Watch fought street by street; the Antinium sent only a handful of Soldiers.

stage.line: Dead things sprint up the road towards the open gate, howling. Far behind them something huge and white drags itself along, and its red eyes fill you with dread.

waves.line: Relc and Watch Captain Zevara plant themselves on the road in front of the gate.
A bloated Crypt Lord lumbers up the road behind a new pack of the dead, spitting black bile.
Ghouls come bounding out of the dark in long leaps.
Pisces steps out of thin air and snaps the necks of the dead with a flick of his fingers.
A few Antinium Soldiers crash into the dead: all the Soldiers Ksmvr will spare.

stage.note: Design: 16 foes in 3 waves and a few allies; canon has thirty thousand dead and fights in every street. The map is the east gate; the dead came through the north and east gates. Skinner stays out of reach here (canon: he meets Relc and leaves for the inn). Hours are a guess.

hooks.news: The dead poured into Liscor at sunset. At the east gate a Human stood with the Watch and helped cut down a Crypt Lord before the line gave way.

canon_ref.note: Evening of day 39. Skinner's [Terror] makes the gate guards flee. Ksmvr brings 15 Soldiers: the Queen's Rite must not be disturbed. Relc, immune to fear through [Indomitable Will], drives Skinner off; it raises the fallen and heads east.

b1.skinner_leads_the_dead_into_liscor.summary: Thousands of dead run at Liscor at sunset, and Skinner's red stare makes the gate guards flee with the gates still open. The Watch fights street by street; Pisces snaps necks for them. Ksmvr brings only fifteen Soldiers. Relc stands up to Skinner, so it raises the fallen and turns towards the inn.

canon_ref.note: Night of day 39. The mad Worker is one of the Aberrations that fled the Hive (Ksmvr). Knight is not an NPC (he dies in 1.61). Other names: Bishop, Vladimir, Calabrian, Emanuel, Garry, Milner-Barry, Belgrade, Jose, Magnus, Anand.

b1.workers_name_themselves.summary: Erin feels an alarm of danger at sunset. That night a Worker gone mad blames her and pins her with a sword; another Worker breaks its neck. He is Knight. About thirty Workers of her chess club have left the Hive and named themselves; now they ring the inn with swords, rocks and rolling pins.

system.name: [Indomitable Will]
system.note: Makes him immune to Skinner's fear, like the Antinium.

system.name: The Gecko of Liscor
system.note: His nickname from his army days.

system.name: Breathes fire
system.note: She is Oldblood (1.63): a Drake who can breathe fire, at a cost to her breath.

system.name: Snaps the necks of the dead
system.note: He cannot do it to Wights or Crypt Lords.
